description: Phase 0 performance budget (T-204), enforced by scripts/bench-gate.mjs (verify.sh full). Scenario: solid cantilever per grid, tol 1e-4, single thread; warm = set_solid(3x3 top-surface carve) + warm-started solve, median of 10 carves; load = setup + cold solve. Times in ms. Results and analysis: docs/perf-results.md. Edit limits by hand; refresh `baseline` with `node scripts/bench-gate.mjs --record`.

regression.description: Fail when a metric exceeds baseline x ratio AND baseline + min-abs. Iterations are compared on any machine (deterministic); times only when the CPU model equals the baseline's.
